title: Pricing: Starter, Pro and Premium Plans | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC pricing: Starter at $24.50, Pro at $35 or Premium at $63 a month, with 200 to 600 credits for product photos and videos. Compare plans today.
h1: AIVideosUGC Pricing for Product Photos and Videos
lead: AIVideosUGC pricing is three monthly plans, each with a set number of credits to spend on product photos and short videos. Every job shows its cost before it begins.
card: Three monthly plans and the credits each one includes.
intro: Pick a plan based on how much content you make in a month. Starter comes with 200 credits for $24.50 a month, Pro with 300 credits for $35, and Premium with 600 credits for $63. Your credits work across the photo and video tools, so you can spend them on white background shots one week and vertical video ads the next.
credits_explained: Credits pay for the jobs you run. A product photo uses 24 credits; video uses 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. The exact cost appears before you start.
The cost appears before you start, and if a job fails its credits return to your balance automatically.
teams: Need more credits for a team or an agency? Email support@aivideosugc.com with roughly how many videos and photos you make each month, and we'll suggest the right setup.

faq.q: Which plan should a small shop start with?
faq.a: Start with Starter at $24.50 for 200 credits if you refresh a few listings. Move to Pro or Premium when you need more credits for weekly ad testing or many products.

faq.q: Can I use the same credits for photos and videos?
faq.a: Yes. One credit balance covers both product photos and short videos, and each job lists its own cost before you confirm.

faq.q: Can I get a refund for a result I don't like?
faq.a: No. A delivered result is not refunded because you dislike it. If a generation fails, its reserved credits return automatically; for a payment review, use the current Refunds policy and contact support.

faq.q: Are my uploads private on every plan?
faq.a: Yes. Whichever plan you choose, your uploads and finished results are kept in your account and never published.

faq.q: What happens to credits when a job fails?
faq.a: A failed job releases its reserved credits back to your balance automatically. Check the job status and credit history if the balance does not update.

faq.q: How many credits does a photo or video use?
faq.a: A product photo costs 24 credits. Videos cost 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see the exact cost before starting a job.

cta_title: Choose a plan for your next product photo
cta_lead: Compare the credit cost for your next photo or video, then start with the plan that fits your work.
